verdict.rationale: Governance is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack has no documentation of who governs SolidJS, whether a foundation or a single company. The only related item is a community remark that most commits come from the creator, which describes contributor concentration, not a governance or ownership structure.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk
